glosses: lap (upper legs of a seated person)
neck; collum (part of body connecting the head and the trunk)
neck (part of a bone that connects its head to its body)

examples.en: Can I sit on your lap?

examples.text: Tom caiu do colo de sua mãe.
examples.en: Tom fell off his mother's lap.

examples.text: O gato está roncando no meu colo.
examples.en: The cat is snoring in my lap.

examples.text: A criança dormiu no colo da mãe.
examples.en: The child slept on its mother's lap.
